answer: Group identities into small random accountability rings each epoch: every member audits the others' work, and if one fake is exposed, the whole ring's reward is frozen pending re-audit. One honest ring threads its checks quietly through the nebula of participants and reaches the zenith of trust cheaply, while a farm cannot hide a thousand fakes inside rings without each cluster risking the rest — one exposed fake burns its ringmates' payouts, so scale multiplies shared liability instead of profit.
